title: The Cuban Missile Crisis, October1962
publisher: U.S. Department of State · Office of the Historian
summary: The October1962 crisis involved competing assessments and public and private communication. This historical overview supports discussion of uncertainty and the interpretation of messages. The publisher marks the Milestones series retired and no longer maintained.
scope: Historical context only; no contemporary Cuba intelligence or scenario-force validation.

title: Battle of Midway · historical source collection
summary: The Navy collection covers the June1942 Battle of Midway and links intelligence studies, contemporary combat narratives and translated Japanese accounts. These sources support comparison of perspectives; they do not validate the fictional Taiwan exercise.
scope: Historical battle references, not modern regional doctrine or operational guidance.

title: World Oil Transit Chokepoints
summary: EIA maintains a reference on maritime energy transit chokepoints. Use the original publication and its dated data when discussing regional context. Preset queue sizes, schedules and resource levels in REPLAY are authored fictional values.
scope: Reference directory only; no current traffic data or live operating picture is ingested.

title: Natural Earth · data terms
summary: Natural Earth places its map datasets in the public domain. It provides reusable geographic context, with accuracy limitations. This catalog links the source; the current Taiwan game terrain remains the separately pinned OpenFront asset.
scope: Geographic data reuse reference; not a claim that new regional game maps were imported.
